context:
Follow the existing DuckDB pattern (duckdb.py:156-184) for directory detection:
- Delta: check for _delta_log/ subdirectory
- Iceberg: check for metadata/ subdirectory
- Hudi: check for .hoodie/ subdirectory
Then use spark.read.format("<format>").load(path) for each detected format.
Re-register platforms in format_capabilities.py only after tests confirm loading works.
description:
SparkDataLoadMixin._load_data_spark() (spark_execution_mixin.py:45-151) currently
only handles parquet and CSV.  Spark natively supports delta, iceberg, and hudi via
spark.read.format("<format>").load(path), but the mixin lacks format detection and
routing for these formats.

The shared mixin is only part of the Spark-family implementation story.  Some managed
Spark adapters have their own staging/Livy/job-submission load paths and do not
currently route through SparkDataLoadMixin.  This item therefore only closes the
shared loader gap for adapters that actually use the mixin; remaining adapter-family
gaps must be tracked separately.

Once mixin-backed loading code is implemented and verified, only the platforms whose
runtime actually uses the mixin should be re-registered in format_capabilities.py.

anti_patterns.why: Spark has native format support via spark.read.format()
